title: Research: prove soundness of repaired P104 memory propagation
body:
## Summary

PR3214 repaired a P104 output-support omission and left the recurrence's soundness open. This package proves that both repaired memory modes contain every legal source-to-target path under the explicit immutable-X, unread-Y, independent-dirt, monotone equal-frame linear contract.

```text
actual nonzero correction coefficient
  same-dimension signal runs share one frame
  compressed contact retains a subspace witness
  all-source output union retains the coefficient's source
```

The new package includes the proof, a separate point-set recurrence, pinned source correspondence and bounded controls. Credit PR3182 for the memory mechanism, PR3214 for the output repair/path/handoff, and the retained P104 endpoint, relay and native lineage.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR3182's first-source output break loses an eligible source; PR3214 explicitly leaves the repaired recurrence implication open.
  **After:** the proof establishes necessary-support inclusion in both modes. All 7,056 small interval fixtures retain every literal BFS path; fully fixed frames give exact path relations. Both implementations agree on every actual PR3019 output and retain `X1 -> H201 -> Y98`.
- Python 3.12 registered replay passes all three commands, including optimized read-only Git-free replay and four rejection groups. Metadata/pins, strict Ruff checks and staged diff checks pass.
- A separate internal read-only review found no blocking issue in the support induction and independently passed the actual-path and exhaustive controls.

Reproduce with `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-memory-relaxation-soundness`.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

Only a new opt-in research package is added. The theorem's restricted support contract supplies no simultaneous flags, chronological coefficients, dirty restoration, native/hosting/precision/consumer admission, new kappa or selected-frontier update. The selected cold replay is unrun because its sources and construction are unchanged.

Canonical investigation: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2245#discussioncomment-19003091
